confirmed_defect: CDP drain returning received data and a reader error in the same state discarded the received data; queued later chunks could also be lost.
fix: Drain all already received page chunks, deliver final data before propagating the reader error. The error remains terminal even if a finish frame was received.
validation_scope: Offline fault fixtures and local real CC transport checks. This does not fix or identify the remote connection closure.

planned_protocol_transition.mechanism: Checkpoint protocol code now retains prior local slots across transport stages. The running campaign source guard will refuse its next checkpoint after result.json is written. No CC process is signalled.

real_cc_probe_setup_failure.reason: New drain observer matched the PATCH_JS source string and attempted dictionary access on its installed-string return value. Fixed predicate to match only a drain invocation.
